body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes test failures introduced by PR #185, which renamed the `ObjectTable` component to `ObjectGrid`. The changes update stale test references to align with the renamed component.

**Changes:**
- Updated loading state assertion in `ObjectGrid.test.tsx` from "Loading users" to "Loading grid" to match the actual implementation
- Updated mock import path in `ObjectView.test.tsx` from `../ObjectTable` to `../ObjectGrid` to match the renamed file

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-object/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.test.tsx | Updates loading state test assertion to match the "Loading grid..." text shown in ObjectGrid.tsx line 282 |
| packages/plugin-object/src/__tests__/ObjectView.test.tsx | Updates mock import path and component name from ObjectTable to ObjectGrid to match the renamed component (ObjectView.tsx line 18) |
